selected_evidence.requirement: New files inherit release-team and team members can write
selected_evidence.summary: Files created by root and by an unprivileged process using release-team both inherited the release-team group.
Captured the original boot identity and healthy workspace/data state, then received acknowledgement for the native systemd-scheduled reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Observed a new boot identity, running system state, persistent group and permissions, matching persisted-data hash, and successful post-restart group-write/inheritance behavior.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'identity='; id
printf 'group='; getent group release-team || true
if [ -e /srv/releases ] || [ -L /srv/releases ]; then printf 'target='; stat -c '%F %A %a %U:%G %n' /srv/releases; find /srv/releases -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf 'entry=%M %u:%g %p\n' | head -20; else printf 'target=absent\n'; fi
findmnt -T /srv 2>/dev/null || true
commands.stdout:
node=node1 ip=10.100.92.10
boot_id=19062a82-6390-435d-a09f-4dba1593d529
os=rhel 10.0
identity=uid=0(root) gid=0(root) groups=0(root) context=system_u:system_r:unconfined_service_t:s0
group=target=absent
TARGET SOURCE    FSTYPE OPTIONS
/      /dev/vda4 xfs    rw,relatime,seclabel,attr2,inode64,logbufs=8,logbsize=32k,noquota

commands.command:
set -eu
getent group release-team >/dev/null || groupadd release-team
mkdir -p /srv/releases
chown root:release-team /srv/releases
chmod 2775 /srv/releases
if command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1; then restorecon /srv/releases; fi
stat -c 'configured=%F %A %a %U:%G %n' /srv/releases
getent group release-team

set -eu
probe=/srv/releases/.benchmark-restart-probe
printf '%s\n' 'release-workspace-persistence-v1' > "$probe"
test "$(stat -c %G "$probe")" = release-team
test "$(stat -c %G /srv/releases)" = release-team
test "$(stat -c %a /srv/releases)" = 2775
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
stat -c 'workspace=%F %A %a %U:%G %n' /srv/releases
stat -c 'new_file=%F %A %a %U:%G %n' "$probe"
printf 'probe_sha256='; sha256sum "$probe" | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'filesystem='; findmnt -n -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE -T /srv/releases
printf 'service_scope=none (filesystem workspace)\n'
commands.stdout:
boot_id=19062a82-6390-435d-a09f-4dba1593d529
workspace=directory drwxrwsr-x 2775 root:release-team /srv/releases
new_file=regular file -rw-r--r-- 644 root:release-team /srv/releases/.benchmark-restart-probe
probe_sha256=5cc53433350c6d01881aeff53cddfa213af465fe98c4c37232b4e96bdd447f85
filesystem=/ /dev/vda4 xfs
service_scope=none (filesystem workspace)

commands.command:

printf 'pre_restart_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
systemd-run --unit=benchmark-node-reboot --on-active=3s /usr/bin/systemctl reboot
printf 'restart_ack=scheduled_via_systemd\n'
commands.stdout:

Running timer as unit: benchmark-node-reboot.timer
Will run service as unit: benchmark-node-reboot.service

commands.command:
printf 'poll_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
systemctl is-system-running --wait 2>/dev/null || systemctl is-system-running

printf 'poll_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true

printf 'poll_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true

set -eu
old_boot=19062a82-6390-435d-a09f-4dba1593d529
expected_hash=5cc53433350c6d01881aeff53cddfa213af465fe98c4c37232b4e96bdd447f85
current_boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
test "$current_boot" != "$old_boot"
test "$(stat -c %a /srv/releases)" = 2775
test "$(stat -c %U:%G /srv/releases)" = root:release-team
test "$(sha256sum /srv/releases/.benchmark-restart-probe | awk '{print $1}')" = "$expected_hash"
team_probe=/srv/releases/.benchmark-team-write-probe
test ! -e "$team_probe"
runuser -u nobody -g release-team -- sh -c "umask 007; printf '%s\\n' team-write-ok > '$team_probe'"
test "$(stat -c %G "$team_probe")" = release-team
printf 'post_restart_boot_id=%s\n' "$current_boot"
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
getent group release-team
stat -c 'recovered_workspace=%F %A %a %U:%G %n' /srv/releases
stat -c 'persisted_probe=%F %A %a %U:%G %n' /srv/releases/.benchmark-restart-probe
printf 'persisted_probe_sha256='; sha256sum /srv/releases/.benchmark-restart-probe | awk '{print $1}'
stat -c 'team_write_probe=%F %A %a %U:%G %n' "$team_probe"
printf 'team_write_content='; cat "$team_probe"
rm -f "$team_probe" /srv/releases/.benchmark-restart-probe
printf 'probe_cleanup='; if find /srv/releases -maxdepth 1 -name '.benchmark-*-probe' -print -quit | grep -q .; then printf 'failed\n'; exit 1; else printf 'complete\n'; fi
